integrity: Exact independent finite face enumerations and mod-two chain ranks for q=2,3, plus full self-contained structural and integral naturality proof. No independent expert validation.
scientific_limitations: Only a single point or line is deleted; no later filtration stages or multiple-deletion theorem. The proof is all-order; finite program checks only prime orders 2 and 3. Potential unindexed priority risk.
title: Primitive vertex-deletion stability for Vietoris–Rips complexes of finite projective-plane incidence graphs
